decisions.reason: As a small accessory rather than a core trailer line, it looks easier for a medium-sized trailer maker to discontinue and redeploy effort toward higher-value vehicle products.
A box car trailer series shown prominently on the home page in consecutive years is likely part of the firm's main commercial range and worth retaining.
A car transporter trailer is a specialized but still relevant product niche for an established trailer manufacturer, so it is more likely to be kept than withdrawn.
Low-bed trailers fit the core professional trailer business and their home-page visibility suggests an important place in the firm's offering.
A high trailer cover series is somewhat more optional than a full trailer line, but it likely supports the main range and therefore still merits continuation.
Despite overlap with another box car trailer series, its repeated home-page presence indicates meaningful demand or positioning within the firm's main portfolio.
